description: Product sales order and quote management. Creates invoices/quotes for inventory items sold to clients. Two-panel layout: top form (header + line items grid) and bottom inventory picker (item list + size list). Generates printable quote PDFs. Toolbar buttons change based on order state (new vs saved vs quoted).
printForms: Instrument Quote PDF — TSI letterhead, customer/contact/rep/dates, line items with Qty/Unit Price/Total, notes, Sub Total/Shipping/Sales Tax/Total, barcode
